_meta.description: NFL franchise colorways by era, post-1970 merger. For rendering generic era-accurate jerseys (no logos, no wordmarks). Years are SEASON years (1995 = the 1995 season). Generated from general knowledge — every entry has a confidence flag. VERIFY all 'low' entries against teamcolorcodes.com and Gridiron Uniform Database before launch; transition years may be off by a season.

fields.eraStyle: renderer treatment: classic (pre-'78 chunky sleeve stripes), stripes ('78-'95 two-tone), nineties ('96-'11 piping), modern ('12+ color-blocked yoke)
fields.tricode: era-correct city code when it differs from the modern key (OAK Raiders, SD Chargers, STL Rams...)

_meta.relocations: Franchises keyed by MODERN tricode. Historical identities (Oilers, St. Louis Cardinals/Rams, San Diego Chargers, Baltimore Colts, Oakland/LA Raiders...) are era entries under the modern key with identity + tricode.
